summary: Shared library 1.1.1 (security hardening), compiled into every service's image: VerifyToken no longer caches derived keys (PBKDF2-SHA256 2500 on every call), and RiskCheck, StockCheck, Rank and Quote seal each decision with an iterated SHA-256 audit chain (24000 / 12000 / 36000 / 24000 rounds). One image, five services, each slowed by its own amount; gated by an A/B of each.
